evals.prompt: Create a new agentic project for a private planning task.
evals.expected_output: Create the project under `.agents/projects.local/<project-name>/` without a force-add workflow.
assertions: The default project creation does not create a project-local `.gitignore`.

evals.prompt: Promote an existing hidden project for repository check-in.
evals.expected_output: Move the project to `.agents/projects/<project-name>/` and use normal repository ignore behavior.
assertions: Promotion changes the project root from `.agents/projects.local/` to `.agents/projects/`.
The promoted project does not require `git add -f`.

evals.prompt: Create temporary evaluation output in an agentic project.
evals.expected_output: Keep temporary output under `tmp/` and rely on the applicable global or repository ignore rule.
assertions: Temporary output remains under the project's `tmp/` directory.
A project-local `.gitignore` is added only when the applicable global and repository rules do not ignore `tmp/`.
